name: coupon
title: Coupon
description: Coupons people actually want to tap — a vivid value panel (sunburst, confetti, waves…) joined to a details panel by a perforated tear line with real cut-outs. Ten themes, five outlines (ticket, stamp, receipt, scallop, cut-out), copyable code, Apply button, live countdown, applied / used / expired / locked states, a light sweep, and an optional 3D tilt with a holo sheen that flips over to the T&C.
summary: A perforated coupon with a copyable code that can tilt in 3D and flip to its terms.
usage:
import { Coupon } from '@/components/ui/coupon';

<Coupon
  value="50%"
  unit="Off"
  title="Your first order, on us"
  code="GLOW50"
  onApply={applyCoupon}
/>
behavior: Tapping the code chip calls onCopy and flips its icon to a check. The T&C link turns the coupon over to its terms.
With tilt it leans toward your finger with a moving reflection, holo adds a rainbow sheen, and shine sweeps light across the value panel.
The code chip is a button that reads the copy label and the code. Apply is a button with disabled and selected state.
props: What the offer is and its conditions.
Promo code in a dashed chip — tap to copy when onCopy is set.
Live countdown ("Ends in 05:42:10"); turns expired when it passes.
Shown on the back — the T&C link turns the coupon over.
Applied shows a green ring; used / expired dim with a stamp; locked goes grey.
Why it's locked ("Add ₹120 more to unlock").
Preset, or { fill, ink, accent?, body?, bodyInk?, pattern? } — fill can be a gradient.
Value panel on the left, or on top.
Outline: notches, perforations, torn zigzag ends, wavy edges, or a dashed cut-here line.
Compact for long lists, large for a hero.
A light sweep across the value panel every few seconds.
3D tilt toward the finger; rainbow foil sheen; slow sway at rest.
Called from the code chip — wire it to expo-clipboard.
Tap on the coupon itself (open details, select it).
{ copy?, copied?, apply?, applied?, used?, expired?, locked?, endsIn?, terms?, termsTitle?, back? }
